name: DescribeDomainCcActivityLog

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names to query. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,).

If this parameter is left empty, the aggregated data of all accelerated domain names is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes.

If this parameter is left empty, data from the last 24 hours is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

最小数据粒度为5分钟。

若该参数为空，默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The trigger object.

If this parameter is left empty, all block events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
触发对象。

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: trigger_object

parameters.help_en:
The value of the trigger object.

If this parameter is left empty, all block events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
触发对象值

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The name of the custom rule. Valid values:
default_normal: Normal mode rule.
default_attack: Emergency mode rule.

If this parameter is left empty, all block events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
自定义规则名。取值：
正常模式规则：default_normal。
紧急模式规则：default_attack。

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 30
parameters.name: page_size

ActivityLog.description_en: The list of block event logs

RuleName.description_en: The name of the custom block rule

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time slice. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC
TimeStamp.description_zh: 时间片起始时刻。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

Value.description_en: The value of the trigger object

PageIndex.description_en: The page number of the returned data

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
